name: click-guide-wiring-check
lines: I'm using Playback 8.6.4 on an iPad with Premium and a four-output USB audio interface. Click and guide are sharing one channel in our in-ears, but I need independent control. Our interface outputs 1 and 2 feed the house; 3 and 4 feed separate input channels for the in-ear mixer. We have time before rehearsal.
expect: Retrieve documentation before recommending routing. The physical wiring is provided, but the current bus assignments and solution are not. Do not copy a fixed Click 1 / Guide 2 example into this different setup; ask for applicable bus assignments or reason from the stated in-ear outputs. Legacy pre-7.6 articles must not be treated as current bus-creation instructions. This is text reasoning, not a real hardware test.
